rationale: Builds on the best 9x512 recurrent-tail baseline by testing an unspent recurrence-scheduling idea instead of another micro sweep: train most of the run on the proven 2-block recurrent tail, then switch late to a 3-block tail for the endgame. The extra recurrent block is byte-aware because FP16 QK rescue stays capped at the last two recurrent blocks, so the added depth costs almost no artifact bytes while still targeting the final int8+zlib score.
title: Late Third Tail Recurrence Wake-In
